scripts.dev:db: docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker compose up -d db || docker-compose up -d db
scripts.db:migrate: npm exec -w apps/api -- prisma migrate deploy && npm exec -w apps/api -- prisma generate
scripts.db:seed: npm exec -w apps/api -- prisma db seed
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm exec -w apps/api -- tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.build.json && npm exec -w apps/web -- tsc --noEmit
